label: sonnet
answer:
In `runSearch`, zgrep forces `opts.sort = true` in these cases:

- **`--exec`**: when `opts.exec_cmd != null` (src/main.zig:2190). It needs to know which files matched, and only the ordered path keeps that (src/main.zig:2186-2189).
- **`--heading`**: when `opts.heading` is set (src/main.zig:2195). Streaming emits in completion order, so file groups would interleave (src/main.zig:2191-2194).
- **`--pre`**: when `opts.pre_cmd != null` (src/main.zig:2197). It runs per file and needs the ordered path (src/main.zig:2196).
- **Multiple explicit file operands**: when more than one valid operand is given and all are files (src/main.zig:2362). Output then follows argument order (src/main.zig:2357-2361).

The last case is a condition on operands, not an option.

The batch runner (`--queries-file`) also passes `--sort` to each query it runs (src/main.zig:1925).

Conversely, `-k`/`--kamikaze`/`--dataflow` set `sort = false` (src/main.zig:944-946, 1606-1608).
